delete_message: Its message in {channel} is deleted too. Members keep the roles they already picked.
discard_message: Your edits to this menu haven't been saved.
editor_channel_blocked: The bot can't post in the selected channel. Pick another one or fix its permissions.
editor_confirm_silent_hint: Members still get a private note if something goes wrong.
editor_confirm_subtitle: Sends a private note only they can see, listing the roles added and removed.
editor_hint_text_help: Shown in the dropdown before anyone picks.
editor_invalid_duplicate: Each role can only be on a menu once
editor_invalid_name_length: Names can be up to {max} characters
editor_keep_one_subtitle: Members can switch roles but can't clear their pick.
editor_max_options_title: {max} is the most a menu can hold
editor_message_hint: Leave empty to post the menu's name and a list of its options.
editor_message_placeholder: Click to write the message, or leave it empty for a simple list of the options
editor_message_preview_description: Shown above the dropdown or buttons
editor_name_hint: Only staff see this, and it titles the default message.
editor_pick_any_text: Members turn each role on or off.
editor_pick_one_text: Choosing a role swaps out the one they had.
editor_required_role_hint: Members without this role get a private note saying they need it.
editor_type_buttons_text: A button per role, five to a row.
editor_type_dropdown_text: One tidy list with room for descriptions.
import_copy_subtitle: Uses the text and embeds from the old message
import_empty_text: Older emoji role setups made with the old command show up here.
import_intro: Older setups had members add an emoji under a message to get a role. Move one to a role menu and members pick from a dropdown or buttons instead.
import_retire_subtitle: Stops the old emoji setup and clears its emojis. If the bot posted the original message, it's deleted.
list_empty_text: Post a message with a dropdown or buttons, and members pick their own roles. Pronouns, colors, pings, regions: one menu each.
list_import_hint: You have {count} older emoji role setups you can move over.
menu_channel_missing: Its channel was deleted. Edit the menu, pick a new channel, and save to post it again.
notify_moved: Moved to a role menu in {channel}
preview_empty: Add an option to see the menu
preview_paused: Paused: the dropdown or buttons are greyed out in Discord.
warn_bot_manage_roles: The bot doesn't have Manage Roles, so menus can't give out roles until it does.
